A GAME THAT WAS IN BARCELONA'S CONTROL AT ONE POINT. DEFENSE LETTING THE TEAM DOWN. Thoughts? #fcblive 🔵🔴
This game was ours to take after Lamine's goal. Very disappointing.
Thoughts on Anthony Gordon's performance today?

The club should've at least signed a low-cost CB in the summer.

If there were funds for Julian Alvarez it's impossible to believe there weren't funds for a CB. We didn't even go for Ruud Nijstad properly.

𝐁𝐢𝐠𝐠𝐞𝐬𝐭 𝐩𝐨𝐬𝐢𝐭𝐢𝐯𝐞 of the night.

Stopped Kvara completely, scored a golazo. Xavi Espart should be the starting RB from now on.

Also, how don't you get at least a YELLOW for this?

Joao Neves wasn't even anywhere near the ball.

🚨🎙️| Désiré Doué: “Stealing spotlight from Lamine? I don’t think I stole the spotlight from anyone. I’m playing my own football for my team. Lamine is a great player, of course, and there are a lot of great players at Barcelona. So, well done to them. They played well tonight.” #fcblive
🚨🎙️| Gerard Martín: “I was playing with slight discomfort... but we have to play these matches.” #fcblive
🚨🎙️| Gerard Martín: "This defeat does not affect us for El Clasico. We're going out to BEAT Real Madrid on Sunday." #fcblive

🚨🎙️| Hansi Flick: “It's not an excuse, but we have to understand that we made mistakes because we are NOT FRESH. The effort that the team has had to do in the last couple of weeks has been unbelievable. It wasn't an easy match, but we delivered positive things.” #fcblive
🚨🎙️| Hansi Flick: “Things haven't ended today. The titles, especially the Champions League, will be decided in June.” #fcblive

🚨🎙️| Xavi Espart: “We knew it would be a very difficult match because they have a fantastic team, but I think we have to take the positives from it. We fought with 100% commitment, and in the end, small details decided the game. This also helps us identify what we need to improve and continue developing.

My goal? Scoring my first Champions League goal feels bittersweet because we wanted the three points. Now we have to focus on Sunday.” #fcblive

🚨🎙️| Hansi Flick: “To see Xavi Espart playing at SUCH A LEVEL is incredible. It looks like he has been in the first team for 3 or 4 seasons. How he defended, how he attacked... I am very happy with him.” #fcblive
